current_implementation_observations: NonlinearCheckpoint is currently schema 1 and stores model_signature, completed_step, load_factor, displacement, material_states and continuation_state.
The NPZ store writes a temporary file in the target directory and replaces the canonical path; no composite state or component digests are persisted.
Fixed-load and arc-length restoration use separate session methods, and adaptive checkpointing is currently rejected by the solver.
The current model signature includes nodes, elements, materials, boundary conditions, loads, distributed loads and analysis settings but omits several model entities and explicit state topology.
The repository contains both material_state.state_digest and nonlinear.deterministic_state_digest implementations.
target_state_authority: Exactly one accepted NonlinearState; a checkpoint is a persisted accepted state, never a trial or controller-only snapshot.

target_checkpoint_schema.schema_version_semantics: A reader must reject unsupported versions explicitly. A v1 reader may migrate only within the bounded compatibility policy; all writes after WP02 implementation use v2.

serialization_contract.container: NPZ with a canonical metadata_json member and allow_pickle=false
serialization_contract.canonical_payload: Use the tagged canonical representation already defined by deterministic_state_digest for mappings, scalars and NumPy arrays.
serialization_contract.mapping_order: Sort mapping entries by canonical encoded key; never depend on insertion order.
serialization_contract.float_encoding: Encode finite floats by exact float.hex() representation before hashing/serialization.
serialization_contract.array_encoding: Preserve dtype.str, shape and C-order numerical bytes; object and non-numeric arrays are rejected.
serialization_contract.arbitrary_objects: Forbidden; no pickle and no executable deserialization.

digest_contract.algorithm: SHA-256 over the canonical tagged state representation
digest_contract.save: Validate the accepted state, compute all component digests and the composite digest, then persist them.
digest_contract.load: Decode and validate the state, recompute all digests, and reject any persisted/recomputed mismatch.
digest_contract.material_digest_policy: material_state.state_digest remains a compatibility helper initially and must delegate or be deprecated so it cannot define a second accepted-state identity.

v1_compatibility.legacy_signature: Validate a v1 checkpoint with the v1 signature rules before constructing a v2 accepted state.
migration: Map displacement, load_factor, material_states and continuation_state into NonlinearState.
Initialize contact_state to an empty mapping only when the selected route has no stateful/contact-bearing topology.
Initialize accepted_increment_metadata with an explicit migration marker and do not claim historical metadata that v1 did not store.
Recompute all component digests and the composite digest; v1 has no persisted composite digest to trust.
Write the next checkpoint in schema 2.
v1_compatibility.supported_scope: Existing bounded contact-free fixed-load and arc-length restart cases whose v1 material topology and continuation payload validate.
v1_compatibility.rejected_scope: Contact-bearing or stateful-contact v1 checkpoints are rejected explicitly until OD-029-02 is resolved; no empty contact state may silently stand in for missing history.
v1_compatibility.historical_information: A migration marker records that accepted metadata and digests were reconstructed, not recovered from v1.

must_include: element type, ordered connectivity and material reference
all physically relevant analysis parameters, including load path, kinematics, contact and continuation controls
accepted-state topology and state schema version
must_not_include: pure output, cache, reporting and storage settings
current_gaps_to_close_in_wp02_b: The current _signature_payload does not explicitly include contacts, springs, concentrated masses, MPC/RBE entities or DOF/state topology.
The non-physical signature exclusion list must be explicit rather than relying on accidental parameter inclusion.

ordering: Global increment is accepted and the composite NonlinearState is published.
The accepted state is validated and serialized to a temporary file in the target directory.
The temporary file is flushed/durably prepared as supported by the platform.
The temporary file is atomically replaced into the canonical path.
Optional retained-step copies are created only after the canonical checkpoint is valid.
save_atomicity_contract.physical_convergence_independence: Checkpoint persistence never decides convergence and never rolls back a physically accepted state.
save_atomicity_contract.failure_behavior: A write failure raises CHECKPOINT_FAILURE and cannot expose a half-written canonical checkpoint; automatic cutback is forbidden by default.

restart_equivalence_contract.level_1: Save/load of an accepted v2 state reproduces displacement, load factor, material, contact, continuation, accepted metadata, component digests and composite digest.
restart_equivalence_contract.level_2: Continuous and interrupted-plus-restarted fixed/adaptive/arc-length runs produce equivalent accepted paths and final state under the frozen thresholds.

contact_state_contract.current_scope: Frictionless penalty contact may persist an empty contact state because the current bounded path is stateless.
contact_state_contract.future_scope: The top-level schema must accept path-dependent contact/slip state and validate pair identity and entry topology without changing the checkpoint envelope.
contact_state_contract.claim_boundary: No frictional-contact restart support is claimed by WP02-A.

owner_decisions.OD-029-01: OPEN; unchanged and blocks WP09 only.
owner_decisions.OD-029-02: CLOSED; READ_V1_WRITE_V2_BOUNDED. Contact-free and proven stateless-compatible v1 migration is allowed; ambiguous/stateful contact-bearing v1 is rejected.
